WITH bot_row AS (
    SELECT b.id,
           b.nome,
           b.evolution_instance,
           b.instrucoes
      FROM app.app_bot b
     WHERE lower(b.evolution_instance) = lower($1)
       AND b.ativo = 'Y'
     ORDER BY b.atualizado_em DESC
     LIMIT 1
)
SELECT $1 AS instance,
       $2 AS text,
       $3 AS phone,
       COALESCE(
         (SELECT row_to_json(bot_row) FROM bot_row),
         json_build_object(
           'id', NULL,
           'nome', 'Bot Atendimento',
           'evolution_instance', $1,
           'instrucoes', 'Bot simples de atendimento'
         )
       ) AS bot,
       COALESCE(
         (
           SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(action_row) ORDER BY action_row.ordem)
             FROM (
               SELECT a.id,
                      a.nome,
                      a.tipo,
                      a.gatilho,
                      a.resposta_fixa,
                      a.ordem
                 FROM app.app_bot_action a
                 JOIN bot_row b ON b.id = a.app_bot_id
                WHERE a.ativo = 'Y'
                ORDER BY a.ordem ASC, a.nome ASC
             ) action_row
         ),
         '[]'::json
       ) AS actions,
       COALESCE(
         (
           SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(faq_row) ORDER BY faq_row.ordem)
             FROM (
               SELECT f.id,
                      f.pergunta,
                      f.resposta,
                      f.palavras_chave,
                      f.ordem
                 FROM app.app_bot_faq f
                 JOIN bot_row b ON b.id = f.app_bot_id
                WHERE f.ativo = 'Y'
                ORDER BY f.ordem ASC, f.pergunta ASC
             ) faq_row
         ),
         '[]'::json
       ) AS faqs;

WITH contato AS (
  INSERT INTO app.app_contato (nome, telefone)
  VALUES ('WhatsApp', $1)
  ON CONFLICT (telefone) DO UPDATE SET telefone = EXCLUDED.telefone
  RETURNING id
),
contato_sel AS (
  SELECT id FROM contato
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM app.app_contato WHERE telefone = $1 LIMIT 1
),
sess AS (
  INSERT INTO app.app_session (contato_id, canal, identificador_externo)
  SELECT id, 'whatsapp', $1 FROM contato_sel
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM app.app_session s
    JOIN contato_sel c ON s.contato_id = c.id
    WHERE s.canal='whatsapp' AND s.identificador_externo=$1
  )
  RETURNING id, contato_id
),
sess_sel AS (
  SELECT id, contato_id FROM sess
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.id, s.contato_id FROM app.app_session s
  JOIN contato_sel c ON s.contato_id = c.id
  WHERE s.canal='whatsapp' AND s.identificador_externo=$1
  LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO app.app_mensagem (session_id, contato_id, remetente, mensagem)
SELECT id, contato_id, 'usuario', $2 FROM sess_sel;
